reference.color: BT.709, full-range YUV 4:2:0 as reported by FFmpeg

coverage.cropReviewResolution: 256 x 190 pixels per crop, assembled into eight 64-frame contact sheets
coverage.fullFrameOverview: overview-01.jpg; one frame at or after each whole second
coverage.limitation: All frame crops were visually inspected at contact-sheet scale. This is not native-resolution scrutiny of every source pixel. Camera motion prevents reliable recovery of a unique wave speed, wavelength or simulation algorithm.

timelineObservations.visible: Camera descends and orbits. Clear turquoise foreground with distorted dark underlying features gives way smoothly to a bluer, more reflective low-angle surface. Broad crests and smaller irregular ripples coexist. No visible abrupt material switch at reviewed scale.

Low grazing view emphasizes rounded rolling crests and compressed distant detail. Soft grey-blue reflection streaks deform between frames. Water does not behave as a static flat color or isolated circular ripples.

Orbit continues; larger wave shapes and finer bright broken streaks coexist. Foreground retains subtle cyan below the blue reflective surface. No obvious grid seam or discrete LOD ring at reviewed scale.
Blue surface dominates with fine pale reflection patches. Foam is mainly a thin hull-contact line, rather than a uniform open-water white layer. No visible focus-plane transition.
View gradually becomes more elevated. Turquoise foreground and underwater-looking dark features become easier to see. Surface still carries pale moving highlights over the visible underlying detail.
Clearer elevated view. Fine highlights begin concentrating toward the foreground/right while darker distorted patches remain visible. The transition is gradual across successive frames.

Strong broken silvery glints cover portions of the turquoise foreground. Highlights trace irregular surface slopes and are not a single smooth uniform white patch. Distorted underlying features remain visible between glints.

The elevated orbit continues through the last frame with turquoise water, irregular bright glints and dark distorted detail. No visible animation reset at the end, but the recording does not prove seamless looping.

qaAcceptanceCriteria.requirement: Broad rolling surface shapes and finer irregular detail coexist and evolve continuously; avoid uniform parallel stripe motion.
Elevated views retain cyan/turquoise base color while grazing views become more reflective blue-grey; orbiting must not cause abrupt color changes.
Highlight-facing views produce broken irregular silver patches with base water visible between them; avoid a white sheet or detached glitter sprites.
If the implementation lacks sampled scene refraction or submerged-object visibility, classify reference clarity as partial rather than matched.
Water patterns and shallow-depth inputs remain attached to water/world coordinates during camera movement, without screen-space swimming or snapped reposition seams.
The same elapsed time yields the same state at 30 and 60 update rates; pause/resume and quality changes do not reset phases.
Grazing distant detail fades without visible rings, mesh gaps, sudden normal changes or excessive sparkling.
All quality tiers compile without shader or WebGL errors and render finite bounds under supported camera views.
Repeated creation and disposal release owned geometry, textures and materials without increasing retained renderer resources.
Report tested device, browser, canvas resolution, pixel ratio, tier and timing percentiles; headless software rendering is not mobile-device validation.

implementationVisualQa.status: Final visual review complete; reference-inspired approximation accepted within stated scope
initialFindings: Broad pale white-grey patches covered too much surface compared with all six source crops.
Source has darker blue or turquoise body between narrower silver reflections.
Visible finite-plane edge at reference view was absent from the reference material target.

tunedFindings.feature: Blue-teal base and broken silver glint character
tunedFindings.detail: Substantially closer to native reference crops 03 and 06 after contrast and highlight tuning.

tunedFindings.feature: Layered wave shape and fine surface detail
tunedFindings.detail: Candidate retains broad paint-like reflection bands and larger foreground glints than the recorded comparison view.
No finite-plane edge visible; temporal and all-view checks remain separate.
Opaque approximation cannot show the source submerged detail or actual reflected geometry.
Source camera transform and world units are unknown; two static captures cannot establish temporal equivalence.

implementationVisualQa.recommendation: Use as a lightweight reference-inspired water component. Report the fidelity limits explicitly; obtain target-phone timing before assigning a mobile FPS guarantee.

finalFindings.feature: Blue-teal color and broken silver highlights
finalFindings.detail: Final reference view preserves saturated body color between fine irregular glints, closer to native video water crops than the pale initial render.
Farther reference camera reduces oversized glints. Close stress view still shows broader, softer normal-map bands than parts of the source.
Radial fan regression is absent in final low, medium and high grazing views and in the reference view.
Final phase0 and phase1.2 show changing ripple and glint patterns. This establishes animation presence, not exact source speed or seamless long-duration looping.
The one-pass opaque approximation cannot reproduce true visibility of underwater geometry or actual reflected scene objects.

finalFindings.classification: Not established by this visual review
finalFindings.detail: Emulated viewport screenshots and software-rendered timing must not be presented as phone hardware validation.

horizonRegression.failure: Stretched skirt cells produced radial light-dark fan bands near the horizon.
horizonRegression.resolution: Zero analytic displacement and slope on all stretched-triangle corners, with a smooth fade toward the detailed interior.
horizonRegression.verification: Independent visual comparison of low, medium and high grazing captures plus medium reference capture.
